description: This Go source file defines the 'upgrade' package for Kubernetes kubeadm, specifically handling the upgrade phases for addons such as CoreDNS and kube-proxy. It includes functions to create upgrade phases, determine whether to upgrade addons, and execute addon upgrade logic.

classes.name: workflow.Phase
classes.description: Represents a phase in the kubeadm upgrade workflow, including name, description, flags, and execution function.

methods.name: NewAddonPhase
methods.description: Creates and returns a new workflow.Phase for managing addon upgrades.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeAddons
methods.description: Determines whether addons should be upgraded based on control plane instance statuses.

methods.name: getInitData
methods.description: Extracts initialization data from the workflow.RunData interface.

methods.name: runCoreDNSAddon
methods.description: Executes the upgrade process for the CoreDNS addon.

methods.name: runKubeProxyAddon
methods.description: Executes the upgrade process for the kube-proxy addon.

methods.name: getAddonPhaseFlags
methods.description: Returns command-line flags relevant to specific addon upgrade phases.
